about.title: An offering from
about.subtitle: Swastha NavJeevan was born at the meeting point of bhakti, science and human suffering. It is the work of four institutions that chose to walk together — slowly, carefully, freely.
about.iskconDesc: A spiritual home of bhakti and community — anchoring the SNJ programme in compassion, dharma and service. The temple campus has housed healing gatherings for decades, offering participants a sanctuary where ancient liturgy meets daily life.
about.bvceDesc: Bhaktivedanta College of Vedic Education — the academic and contemplative wing nurturing teachers, researchers and facilitators. BVCE brings structured learning, Vedic scholarship and faculty development to the SNJ curriculum.
about.bahrcDesc: Bhakti Vedanta Ashram & Holistic Research Centre — the research and retreat infrastructure that supports SNJ field work. BAHRC measures outcomes, maintains protocols and drives the evidence-base of every intervention.
about.swaayuDesc: Clinical Ayurveda partner — integrating evidence-based ayurvedic care with the modern integrative oncology framework. Swaayu brings board-certified Ayurvedic physicians into the retreat alongside oncologists.
about.originP1: A clinician, a monk, an oncologist and a teacher sat together with families navigating cancer. They listened beyond the protocols — to fear, to faith, to the small wishes of ordinary life. What they heard was not a clinical gap. It was a human one.
about.originP2: The Holistic Cancer Healing Retreat is the answer they have been shaping ever since — slowly, carefully, with four institutions choosing to walk the same ground, in the same direction, without hurry.

programme.title: A half-day
programme.subtitle: The Holistic Cancer Healing Retreat (HCHR) is a four-session morning gathering — a deliberate, unhurried rhythm of body, mind, intelligence and soul.

sessions.title: Awakening the Body
sessions.desc: Gentle yoga, breath and movement designed for the recovering body. Led by certified yoga therapists trained in cancer care.
sessions.detail: Pranayama, restorative asanas, body scan awareness, gentle qigong-inspired movements. All postures are offered with seated / supine alternatives.

sessions.title: Stillness of Mind
sessions.desc: Mindfulness, guided meditation and breath-based emotional regulation.
sessions.detail: MBSR-aligned techniques, guided imagery, loving-kindness practice, fear-processing dialogue, and structured journaling prompts.

sessions.title: Wisdom of Intelligence
sessions.desc: Integrative oncology insights, nutrition, daily rhythm, ayurvedic counsel.
sessions.detail: Oncologist and Ayurvedic physician co-presentation on evidence-based integrative care, seasonal eating, circadian rhythm, sleep hygiene and supplement safety.

sessions.title: Voice of the Soul
sessions.desc: Bhakti, kirtan, gratitude practice, story circles, prasadam.
sessions.detail: Devotional music, guided story circle (patient voices), gratitude letter writing, satsang with monks, and a shared vegetarian prasadam meal.

programme.scheduleNote: Dates are confirmed each month via the SNJ WhatsApp community. Register early — sessions are capped to ensure personal attention.
programme.whoP1: Patients walking through any phase of cancer — newly diagnosed, in treatment, or in remission.
programme.whoP2: Caregivers and family members carrying the weight of love and uncertainty.
programme.whoP3: Survivors seeking community, ritual, and a meaningful return to daily life.
